svg.title: DIA-005 · A governor, unpinned
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a large flyball governor standing over a steam pipe. A belt from the flywheel spins it, and its two heavy balls are flung wide. A long lever runs from its raised sleeve toward the throttle valve on the pipe, but the lever ends in an empty eye: the rod that should join it to the throttle is drawn only as a rust dashed line, and the real rod lies on the floor. The other end of the lever pushes a hammer against a bell. By the firebox there is a heap of coal and a shovel.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 5 · HOW THESE INTERACT
the rod, still on the floor
DIA-005 · The system senses its own speed and sounds the alarm. Nothing connects the alarm to the throttle.
